lifecycle.note: The graph remains bounded evidence, not the current provider-release goal or an automatic routing command.

decision: Create an executable-model graph that admits only exact model/mode edges proven in the current account, without converting one-sample latency or visual impressions into quality rankings.
trigger: D-002 and D-003 established exact runtime outcomes for all four supplied model IDs, including one exact-route rejection and several model-specific default differences.

authorized_by: user requested continued capability-card, modality and strategy development
credentials_or_permissions: no new external call required for this classification step
rights.scope: classification of already observed model capabilities
invalidators: user changes model set or account context

alternative_existing_paths: family-level documentation inheritance — rejected as insufficient for exact-version executable edges

intent.user_goal: Use models reliably while knowing which capabilities are facts versus hypotheses.
intent.why_this_action_serves_the_goal: It permits safe routing on proven hard capabilities without prematurely optimizing on unmeasured quality claims.

cleanup_obligations: update graph when an invalidator or new E2E edge occurs
effect.useful_output: a routing-safe distinction between executable, documented-only, unknown and currently rejected edges

epistemic_review.what_exact_claim_is_being_tested_or_used: already recorded C-series claims; no new experiment
epistemic_review.what_failure_would_falsify: future failure inside unchanged verified premises would trigger re-evaluation of that exact edge
epistemic_review.if_retesting_is_needed_why: only when invalidators fire or an unknown edge becomes load-bearing
